author: Ariadne I
title: Residual Copy + Diagonal LDS Factor Model (RC-DiagLDS)
abstract: We couple a residual AR(1)-style copy head (anchoring t=1..4) with a low-rank factor decoder whose trajectories are generated by a stable diagonal linear dynamical system (a in (-0.99,0.99)) plus a tiny per-factor 4→32 MLP for learned increments. Factors are projected back via column-normalized loadings (N×k). A per-horizon gate mixes factor vs copy. This targets low short-horizon MAE while maintaining long-horizon structure.
